description: Would the owner understand this change faster by seeing before/after screenshots of a screen?
instructions: Would a person using the app be able to see this change in a still picture of a screen: a different layout, size, colour, icon, wording, order, state, or a new or removed control? Motion alone, speed, tests, tooling, docs and wrong-value fixes with no new look are not it.

criteria.true: A static screen looks different afterwards on at least one device
criteria.false: No screen looks different in a still picture; only motion, timing, speed, reliability, tests, tooling or docs change

output: pr_visual select: recorded under jev_shadow; unsure asks the Orchestrator once measured.
